verdict.rationale: Greptile exposes much of its UI functionality programmatically. `greptile onboard` does "the same setup the dashboard does", greptile.json overrides dashboard settings, and the official MCP server lets agents fetch and resolve review comments and view, search, and create patterns. However, no public REST API or OpenAPI spec was found, and some settings are documented only as dashboard paths (Settings → Code Review → Default Coding Agents). Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose API covering all UI actions, evidence of programmatic control over org/admin settings, and independent confirmation of API–UI parity.
